value.body: A three-year postgraduate degree in Unani medicine after BUMS. MD (Unani) covers subjects such as Moalajat (medicine), Ilmul Advia (pharmacology), Ilaj bit Tadbeer (regimenal therapy) and Amraze Atfal (paediatrics); MS (Unani) covers surgical subjects such as Jarahat (surgery). Programmes are regulated by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM).

items.label: Regulator
items.note: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine

items.label: Entrance exam
items.note: Conducted by NTA; 120 MCQs, Unani paper in Urdu and English

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A recognised BUMS degree, completed one-year internship (or completion by the NCISM cut-off date) and registration. Admission is through AIAPGET. All-India quota seats (about 15%) and seats in central and national institutions are filled through AACCC counselling; state quota seats through state counselling.

value.title: At a glance
items: Unani PG seats are few compared with Ayurveda, and are concentrated in a handful of states.
Private-college fees can be high; check stipends and fee rules for each seat type.
The degree is the usual requirement for teaching posts in Unani colleges and for research roles.
It also supports specialist practice and roles in Ayush hospitals and drug industry.

value.title: Postgraduate students in Unani, by gender
value.note: Small base of 412 students reported by responding institutions; AISHE coverage of Ayush colleges is incomplete, so totals are lower than the real number of seats.
